title: Sponsorship fund for forty children in two districts
story: Cedar Rise Welfare Trust has sponsored children who lost a parent in two rural districts since 2019, and this appeal covers the coming school year for forty of them. Sponsorship pays school fees, a uniform, books and a monthly food allowance paid to the guardian. Our field team visits every household twice a year and the reports are on our website. A portion of each donation supports the operations that make this work possible.
reviewerNote: Information requested. The programme itself is not the problem; the household evidence is good and the field reports are public. The copy says a portion of each donation supports operations and does not say what the portion is, and our policy requires the deduction to be stated on the campaign page before a badge is issued. I asked for the figure and for confirmation of whether the trust that raises the money is also the trust that distributes it. Published positions on how much overhead may be charged range from nothing at all to a fifth among bodies that all consider themselves within the rules, which is exactly why we publish the number and let the donor weigh it instead of assessing it here.
